raw_record.question_text: In the diagram, angle $PQR$ is $20^{\circ}$, and the reflex angle at $P$ is $330^{\circ}$. The line segments $QT$ and $SU$ are perpendicular. What is the size of angle $RSP$?

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a configuration of four relevant straight lines: QP is the upper side, SP is the lower side, QR is the same straight line as QT, and SR is the same straight line as SU. From the text, the reflex angle at P is 330°, so the smaller angle between PQ and PS is 360°−330°=30°. Also from the text, ∠PQR=20°, so line QR/QT is 20° from line QP. Since QT is perpendicular to SU, line SR/SU is 90° from line QR/QT, hence it is 90°−20°=70° from line QP on the relevant side shown in the diagram. Therefore the angle between SR and SP is the difference between 70° and 30°, giving ∠RSP=40°.

推理：P 处的反角是 330°，所以 PQ 与 PS 之间较小的夹角是 360° - 330° = 30°。又因为 ∠PQR = 20°，所以直线 QR/QT 相对于直线 QP 偏转 20°。QT 与 SU 垂直，因此直线 SR/SU 与 QR/QT 相差 90°，所以在图中相关一侧，SR/SU 与 QP 的夹角为 90° - 20° = 70°。而 SP 与 QP 的夹角是 30°，因此 ∠RSP 是 70° - 30° = 40°。
